dialogues.speaker: Aukai
dialogues.text: Haha, I didn't expect to see such a perfect jumping platform here!

dialogues.speaker: Aukai
dialogues.text: Exactly! As a Meztli {RUBY#[D]People of the Springs} warrior, you should hone your martial arts skills constantly just like Tupac, Cochanina, and Uenuku did, even if you're recovering from injuries...

dialogues.speaker: Eisenhardt
dialogues.text: W—Wait! Sir! Just stay calm and let's talk this through...

dialogues.speaker: Eisenhardt
dialogues.text: If you jump from this height, even a professional diver from Fontaine would definitely get injured!

dialogues.speaker: Aukai
dialogues.text: Haha, that's right! That's where the great hero Uenuku's lover was originally from! He chose to plunge into the sea only for reunion with his beloved, much as I've decided to...

dialogues.speaker: Eisenhardt
dialogues.text: Th—Throw yourself into the sea?! No way! I'm not letting you do this!

dialogues.speaker: Aukai
dialogues.text: Exactly! Miss, don't underestimate the swimming skills of us Meztli{RUBY#[D]People of the Springs}... Wait! Hey, don't pull me!
